source_of_truth: shared/priority-palette.svg; color hex codes and mapping below
semantic: Lower integer = greater priority/urgency; this is a visual code, not a change to target obligation rules
rule: for any integer priority >= 5 use P5 colors identically; retain actual numeric label (P6, P7, P8, …)

rules.scope: Both Active and Archived Focus Areas, including badges in detail screens
rules.sort: priority ascending then stable ID ascending; duplicate priority values allowed
rules.expired_priority: Expiry warning styling (yellow 1-14 days, red >=15 days) is independent of priority: expiration surface wins, priority badge retains its normal badge color
rules.visual_only: Priority palette does not alter streak eligibility (P1 obligations), goals, archival semantics or backend data
rules.do_not_color_full_active_cards_by_priori: Use consistent white card surfaces unless pre-existing expiration state defines tinted surface; optional card tints are illustrative only

fallback: any value N >= 5 maps to P5+; never cycle the palette or allocate extra unique colors
accessibility: Always display numeric priority text; color must not be the only channel; keep badge text foreground contrast legible
